title: AI Engineering (Chip Huyen)
blurb: Build real applications on top of foundation models: how they work, how to evaluate them, prompting, RAG and agents, finetuning, data, inference optimization and production architecture.
sources: Chip Huyen, AI Engineering: Building Applications with Foundation Models (O'Reilly, 2025), ch. 1-10

modules.title: 1. Building AI Applications with Foundation Models
modules.summary: Where foundation models came from, what people build with them, how to plan a product, and the AI engineering stack.

lessons.title: From language models to foundation models
Planning AI applications and the AI engineering stack

modules.title: 2. Understanding Foundation Models
modules.summary: Training data, the transformer, scale and scaling laws, post-training (SFT, RLHF, DPO) and sampling.

lessons.title: Sampling, structured outputs and the probabilistic nature of AI

modules.title: 3. Evaluation Methodology
modules.summary: Entropy, cross entropy and perplexity; exact and similarity-based evaluation; AI as a judge; comparative evaluation.

lessons.title: Language modeling metrics: entropy to perplexity
AI as a judge and comparative evaluation

modules.title: 4. Evaluating AI Systems
modules.summary: Evaluation criteria, model selection, build vs buy, public benchmarks and contamination, and your own eval pipeline.

lessons.title: Model selection, build vs buy and public benchmarks

modules.title: 5. Prompt Engineering
modules.summary: In-context learning, system prompts, best practices, chain-of-thought, decomposition and defensive prompt engineering.

lessons.title: Prompts, in-context learning and context length

modules.title: 6. RAG and Agents
modules.summary: Retrieval algorithms, hybrid search, chunking, reranking, query rewriting, contextual retrieval, agents, planning and memory.

lessons.title: Agents: tools, planning, failure modes and memory

modules.title: 7. Finetuning
modules.summary: When to finetune, memory math, numerical formats and quantization, PEFT/LoRA/QLoRA, model merging and hyperparameters.

lessons.title: Memory math, numerical formats and quantization
PEFT, LoRA, model merging and hyperparameters

modules.title: 8. Dataset Engineering
modules.summary: Curating data for quality, coverage and quantity; synthesis and distillation; inspecting, deduplicating, filtering and formatting.

modules.title: 9. Inference Optimization
modules.summary: Bottlenecks and metrics (TTFT, TPOT, MFU, MBU), accelerators, model-level and service-level optimization.

lessons.title: Model optimization: compression, speculative decoding, KV cache
Service optimization: batching, prompt caching, parallelism

modules.title: 10. AI Engineering Architecture and User Feedback
modules.summary: Context, guardrails, routers, gateways, caching, observability, orchestration and collecting user feedback.

lessons.title: Building up an AI application architecture
